label: Diagram 3
caption: Diagram 3 Relationship of ramp gradient to the going of a flight
description:
This diagram, titled Diagram 3 Relationship of ramp gradient to the going of a flight, consists of two comparative cross-sectional drawings, labelled 'a' and 'b'. 

Part a shows a flight of stairs. It features a series of steps with a vertical 'rise' and a horizontal 'going'. The steps are shown with a consistent upward inclination.

Part b shows a ramp. It features a much shallower inclination compared to the stairs in part a. The ramp is shown with a much longer horizontal distance to reach the same vertical height as the stairs.

Accompanying text states: "have restricted mobility find it more difficult to negotiate a ramp than a stair. In addition, adverse weather conditions increase the risk of slipping on a ramp. It is therefore beneficial to have steps as well as a ramp."
